name: headless-fullstack-starter
description: Decoupled TypeScript React/Vite + Express REST API + Prisma starter

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
